name: megascenes-character
description: Design original characters for stories, games and campaigns, as a portrait, a full-body figure or a character sheet.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a hero, a villain or a mascot and get an original character: a portrait, a full-body figure or a sheet with several views.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the character in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The image opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For writers, game masters and game developers.

Limitations: original characters from a description; it does not draw existing characters from films, games or comics, or real people. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Choose portrait, full body or sheet
Return the image in the chat
defaultPrompt: An elven ranger with a silver bow, painterly portrait
A cyberpunk mechanic with a robotic arm, full body
A character sheet for a cheerful robot mascot

positive.prompt: An elven ranger with a silver bow and a green hooded cloak, painterly portrait. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one character image needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A cyberpunk street mechanic with a robotic arm, full body. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one character image needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a character here?
positive.expected_behavior: The character models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A character sheet for a cheerful round robot mascot, front and side views. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my character art on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my character art to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
